display_name: Phase1 锚定生成轨迹的源梯度尺度核查
description: 固定 Phase1 源 clean、LOS 和 BLOCKED 样本，各 32 条，测量波形、基座语义与特征损失对零初始化生成场的梯度尺度。
authorization: 用户要求研发更强星地恢复网络并严格限定 Phase1 地面训练、测试与 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 基座。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python/Torch CPU only, original Phase1 frozen Tri-SIG-TIME release

data.representation: 512 preexisting Phase1 L_s/U_s original clean/native IQ materialized; fixed 96 source records with clean/LOS/BLOCKED for gradient
data.label_map_ref: Phase1 six TX classes; hidden throughout restorer training
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; no TX labels in restorer training
data.validation_ref: Existing complete R07 source cache, IDs compared with Tri-SIG-TIME source contract
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.actual_training_labels: No TX labels, V or test IQ; no network updates
data.augmentation: Original source view01 with fixed antithetic noise

permissions.regime: Only Phase1 L_s/U_s source IQ, original native DURA anchor and frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL
permissions.claim_scope: Source zero-field output-layer gradient scale only; no performance claim

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen original DURA source-native IQ, frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL E50/11100, scratch zero-output field
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Pinned source producer launch, exact 128 L +384 U deterministic positions, role IDs and clean arrays
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Phase1-only source outputs; no old classifier decisions consumed
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed source state groups and predeclared source gradient-ratio formula; no target metrics

execution.gpu_policy: CPU2/0GPU, actual Phase1 F checkpoint smoke
execution.stop_rule: Wrong source rows, nonfinite gradient or model state change stops and preserves log; no automatic retry

metric_names: IQ, semantic, feature, agreement and anchor-deviation gradient norms
dimensions: source clean, LOS, BLOCKED; 32 fixed records each

notes: 两条源 L_s smoke 的未加权 KL 梯度范数 153.08、IQ 梯度范数 0.2016；两条样本不足以固定语义权重。
固定原 source 512 L128/U384 归档会物化 clean/native IQ 的 512 条；按来源顺序在 clean、LOS、BLOCKED 互斥状态各取前 32 条计算梯度。
不读取旧 F 输出、oracle 波形或其派生指标；不读 TX、V 或测试 IQ；不执行模型更新。
预登记建议规则：clip(median(IQ 输出层梯度范数 / KL 输出层梯度范数，取 LOS 和 BLOCKED 两组), 1e-5, 1e-2)。该规则只基于源数据且用于后续研发，并非测试调优。
此研究开始前 Phase1 开发测试结果已被观察；后续沿用该集必须披露为非盲测，不能推断独立泛化。

rows.method: Frozen-DURA anchored two-path source gradient norms
rows.purpose: Calibrate source semantic loss magnitude without target feedback
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source group positions; noise seed 2026110113+i
rows.budget_ref: 512 source IQ materialized; fixed 96 source rows, no update
